about: Draw a pipe from each dot to its partner of the same colour. Pipes can't cross, and in the end every square should be filled. Easy 5x5, Normal 7x7, Hard 9x9; every puzzle is generated with a solution.
controls: Drag from a dot to draw its pipe. Drag back over a pipe to shorten it. Hint and Restart buttons on the right.
name: Flow
tagline: Connect dots of the same colour with pipes that never cross.
